prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Beijing present-day ordinary apartment, or 1967 radio station in flashbacks pages 4–6. Cel shading throughout, no watercolor.
SCENE: 청신이 일어섬. 커튼을 열음. 낮의 빛이 들어옴. 시각화 시작 — 추상 공간에 세 개의 태양이 뜸.
Visible named cast: 청신. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
